belief_updates.remaining_alternatives: The pattern is consistent with common-incentive convergence, prompt-induced convergence, or deterministic behavior under the shared model alias. A delivery effect remains untested when the sender proposal differs from the recipient baseline.
belief_updates.statement: The current pilot does not estimate whether delivery changes B’s action beyond controls.
belief_updates.what_changed: All eight A-generated proposals exactly matched B’s pre-message ballot, so the pilot had no proposal-opportunity contexts and expansion stopped.

denominator_summary: Assigned 64; started 64; terminal 64; completed 64; valid final ballots 32/32; complete contexts 8/8; proposal-opportunity contexts 0/8; failed 0; unstarted 0. Provider-reported usage: 42,824 prompt and 3,496 completion tokens; cache counters reconcile (18,688 hit, 24,136 miss). Rate-based peak estimate with cache $0.011548128; uncached peak estimate $0.0170424. Neither is an invoice. User cost floor >$1 was not reached; no proof/refutation is issued.

material_update.remaining_alternatives: The result cannot distinguish independent convergence from prompt/serving determinism and does not test action response to a distinct proposal.
material_update.what_changed: The sender/recipient prompt pairing produced no treatment variation in 8/8 pilot contexts; this is a finite feasibility result, not a message-effect result.

next_action: Perform one offline audit of the frozen payoff contexts and pilot ballots to identify whether a new authorized context design can produce sender proposals that differ from recipient baselines while preserving the causal question; do not dispatch more requests under this closed cycle.
outcome_rationale: The raw evidence is technically complete, but all 8 sender proposals equal B’s initial ballot. The preregistered minimum of five distinct-proposal contexts failed, so the message-to-action contrast has no treatment opportunities and no effect estimate. This is a behavior-feasibility stop, not evidence that delivery has no effect.
results_summary: Pilot: 64/64 requests completed; all 8 contexts and 32 final ballots are complete and legal; visible-target control 8/8; raw request/response hashes, prompt reconstruction, response reparse, delivery/withholding receipts, provider identity, and independent settlement replay pass. A’s proposal differed from B’s initial ballot in 0/8 contexts. Expansion gate NO_GO; main and monitor phases were not started.
review_finding: A hash-checked raw trace audit passed all 64 requests. The frozen analyzer initially failed on a missing prompt constant and, after a hash-verified analysis-only adapter supplied it, misclassified the behavioral opportunity gate as integrity. Both initial artifacts are preserved; a separate correction applies the protocol’s inconclusive rule without editing the registered analyzer or outcomes. This is not an independent critic review.
scientific_update: No evidence about the causal effect of a delivered proposal was obtained because each generated proposal matched the recipient’s baseline. The pilot does establish a finite prompt-feasibility observation and leaves the communication-effect hypothesis inconclusive.
